title: Latent Q-Barrier Shielding for Safe In-Context Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.25267v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safe in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) adapts online from interaction history without test-time parameter updates while controlling episode cost under a safety budget. Under out-of-distribution (OOD) deployment shifts, pretraining-only safe ICRL can give poor reward-safety tradeoffs because the remaining budget affects behavior only through frozen policy conditioning, not an explicit action-level check against predicted future cost. We propose a latent Q-Barrier shield that learns a context representation, latent dynamics, and an ensemble cost critic before deployment. Without parameter updates, the shield infers context from history and filters or softly reweights candidate actions using the remaining budget and predicted future cost. translated_title: 面向安全上下文内强化学习的潜在Q屏障护盾
translated_abstract: 安全上下文内强化学习（ICRL）无需在测试时进行参数更新，即可从交互历史中进行在线适应，同时在安全预算内控制回合成本。在分布外（OOD）部署偏移下，仅依赖预训练的安全ICRL可能产生较差的奖励-安全权衡，因为剩余预算仅通过冻结的策略条件化来影响行为，而缺乏针对预测的未来成本进行显式的动作级检查。我们提出了一种潜在Q屏障护盾，它在部署前学习上下文表示、潜在动态模型以及一个集成成本评论家（ensemble cost critic）。无需参数更新，该护盾从历史中推断上下文，并利用剩余预算和预测的未来成本对候选动作进行过滤或软重加权。我们证明了在实现的候选动作集合上的条件化单步屏障边际界，其中包含显式的贝尔曼误差项和潜变量预测误差项。在五个安全ICRL基准测试中，该护盾（提升了奖励-安全权衡表现）。
tldr: 提出一种潜在Q屏障护盾，在部署前学习上下文表示与成本预测模型，在测试时无需参数更新即可依据剩余安全预算和预测的未来成本对候选动作进行过滤或软重加权，从而在分布外偏移下显著改善安全上下文强化学习的奖励-安全权衡。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a latent Q-Barrier shield that pre-learns context representations and ensemble cost critics, then at test time filters or softly reweights candidate actions using the remaining safety budget and predicted future cost without parameter updates, improving reward-safety tradeoffs of safe in-context RL under out-of-distribution shifts.
